rule: A row carries a value ONLY if the value was read on the official source page named in `source` on 2026-11-10. Rows whose value is unknown to this session are left blank with status `unverified` and appear on flag.html. Rows marked `computed` are arithmetic performed on verified values in this session; they are labelled as arithmetic, never as official statistics.

rows.metric: Exact lease expiry date

rows.metric: Contract base rent
rows.note: Owner document request. Every wealth figure in the model is therefore denominated per $100,000 of rent, not in dollars of actual rent.

rows.metric: Rent escalation schedule
rows.note: Owner document request.

rows.metric: Renewal option terms (number, length, rent setting, notice date)
rows.note: Owner document request. The notice date determines the last safe date to start a sale process.

rows.metric: Recovery structure (true triple net vs. modified)
rows.note: Owner document request. 'NNN' was asserted in the brief but the lease was not read; a modified-net lease transfers fewer costs and can move net operating income materially.

rows.metric: Building area
rows.note: Owner document request.

rows.metric: Land area
rows.note: Owner document request. Land value is the floor under the asset if the building becomes obsolete.

rows.metric: Year built and year of last major renovation

rows.metric: Assessor's Parcel Number (APN)
rows.note: Deliberately not collected or published. Privacy rule: parcel identifiers must not appear on the site.

rows.metric: Zoning and permitted uses
rows.note: Requires the APN/address. Owner document request.

rows.metric: Drive-through entitlement status
rows.note: A legal non-conforming drive-through is worth less to a re-tenant than a conforming one. Requires the APN and a ZIMAS lookup.

rows.metric: Secured debt outstanding and terms
rows.note: Owner document request. Changes the sell-vs-hold arithmetic through leverage and defeasance.

rows.metric: Prepayment penalty / defeasance cost
rows.note: Owner document request.

rows.metric: Current assessed value and annual property tax bill
rows.note: Requires the APN at the County Assessor. The 2% cap mechanism is verified (X07); the owner's number is not.

rows.metric: Owner's federal and state filing status
rows.note: Determines which rate schedule applies. Never requested in chat; owner document request.

rows.metric: Owner's other real-property holdings and concentration
rows.note: Determines whether this single asset is already a concentration risk. Owner input.

rows.metric: Liquidity needed from this asset and on what timeline
rows.note: Owner input.

rows.metric: Risk tolerance and maximum acceptable loss
rows.note: Owner input. The model presents the loss distribution precisely so this can be answered by the owner, not assumed by the model.

rows.metric: Holding horizon and intended use of proceeds
rows.note: Owner input.

rows.metric: Estate plan / step-up basis considerations
rows.note: Owner input, and a tax-adviser matter. Not modelled here.
